name: com.mylatinlife/data
title: MyLatinLife Data
description: Verified Latin America data: residency, citizenship, tax, safety, passports, clubs and events.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Start here for any question about moving to, living in, retiring in, investing in or getting residency, citizenship or a second passport in Latin America, Spain, Portugal or Italy. One search across everything this server holds: countries, residency/visa/citizenship programs, cities (safety and cost of living), private clubs, golf courses, sovereignty projects, nomad events, MyLatinLife services, articles and videos. Every result has an id; pass it to fetch for the complete sourced record. Call with no arguments for an overview of coverage, topics, row counts, verification dates and how to cite. Use find_visas instead when you need numeric filters (income, investment, physical presence, years to citizenship).

query.description: The question in plain words, or keywords: e.g. "retire on $2,000 a month in South America", "Italian citizenship through grandparents", "does Colombia have military service", "golden visa", "safest cities Mexico". Results come best match first; a named country or region filters, and an amount also runs find_visas. Omit with no other arguments for the overview.

country.description: Only results for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

kind.description: Only this kind of result (topic: one subject of one country, such as its banking or military service). counts in every answer shows how many matched of each kind.

limit.description: How many results to return. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full, sourced record for one id from search: "country:panama" (its summary; every short topic in full, such as tax, banking, property and inheritance tax, cost of living, safety, healthcare, passport, military service, firearms, renunciation and citizenship by descent; and an index of its programs, cities and tax-list status with ids to fetch. Pass topics for the full rows of any topic), "program:panama-pensionado" (requirements, minimums, stay rules, timelines, fees, legal citations), "city:mexico/merida", "club:…", "golf:…", "project:…", "event:…", "service:…", "bloc:mercosur" (settlement agreement), "jurisdiction:Cayman Islands" (tax blacklist status) or "about" (data coverage and citation terms). A bare country or program name also works.

id.description: An id from search, e.g. "country:costa-rica" or "program:panama-friendly-nations-visa"; or a country or program name.

topics.description: For a country: the full rows of these topics. Omit for the digest (short topics in full, programs, cities and tax lists as ids to fetch).

tools.name: find_visas
tools.description: Filter the digital-nomad, retirement (pensionado) and investor visa datasets by entry minimum, type, region, presence and citizenship time; results sort by lowest minimum within each type. This is the numeric filter for those three visa families. For words-based search across the wider residency and citizenship catalog, use search; for one program's full sourced record, fetch "program:<program_id>".

visa_type.description: Visa category to search. Defaults to "any".

max_minimum_usd.description: Only visas whose entry minimum is at or below this.

region.description: A region ("South America", "Central America", "North America", "Caribbean", "Europe") or "Latin America".

countries.description: Only these countries. Country names or slugs, e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"].

max_years_to_citizenship.description: Only visas with a path to citizenship of at most this many years of residency (the program's own figure, or for a digital nomad visa that counts toward permanent residency, the country's naturalization rule). Visas with no known path drop out.

max_presence.description: Only visas whose stay requirement to keep the residency is at most this: visits_only (occasional visits, a few days a year or less), part_year (regular stays, up to about 3 months a year or re-entry every 6 months), most_of_year. Visas without a rating, including digital nomad visas, drop out.

passive_investment.description: true: only investor visas that accept a passive investment (no business to run). Other visa types drop out.

limit.description: How many visas to return, cheapest first within each type. Defaults to 25; count gives the total, so narrow with the filters above.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison. Countries: pass 2 or more and a topic (e.g. tax_systems, cost_of_living, banking, safety, passport_power) for the source rows, or no topic for each country's headline summary. Programs: pass 2 to 8 program ids or names for minimums, citizenship time, stay rules, processing time and fees. Rankings: omit items and pass topic passport_power, crypto_adoption or human_freedom for the whole published ranking.

items.description: Countries (e.g. ["Panama", "costa-rica"]) or programs (e.g. ["program:panama-pensionado", "Paraguay investor"]); do not mix the two.

topic.description: For countries: the dataset topic to compare on. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

tools.name: get_recent_changes
tools.description: Dated change log for tracked datasets, newest first. Includes changed program facts (with old and new values), tax-list additions/removals and changes in what MyLatinLife covers. Dates show when MLL recorded a dataset change, not when a law took effect or a government announced a policy.

country.description: Only changes for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

topic.description: Only changes in this topic. Dataset topic, e.g. "tax_systems", "digital_nomad_visas" or "cost_of_living".

since.description: Only changes recorded on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

kind.description: Only this kind of change. "changed" is a value that changed; the coverage kinds track what MyLatinLife covers.

limit.description: How many changes to return, newest first. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Bulk export of every row in one dataset, optionally limited to one country. Use this to import a topic into a product or workflow, not to look up one answer; ordinary search and comparison tools return complete results without a key. Bulk exports require a commercial API key: https://mylatinlife.com/api/v1/plan?src=tools

country.description: Only rows for this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".
